programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Blackheart
programme.desc: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance.

programme.title: Played
programme.desc: Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Bar 20 Justice
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe).

programme.title: West to Glory
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright).

programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

programme.desc: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. Nevertheless, Craig has the uncanny feeling that his brother is still alive -- and that he's the only one who can save him.

programme.title: Desert Sands
programme.desc: Sheik El Zanal (Keith Larsen) and his faithful sister, Princess Zara (Marla English), plot revenge on an outpost of the French Foreign Legion 15 years after their parents are murdered in cold blood by men dressed as legionnaires. After the brutal massacre of a patrol unit, the fort's newly assigned commander, Capt. David Malcolm (Ralph Meeker), battles the cunning El Zanal and his henchmen while waiting for reinforcements -- and finding himself unexpectedly attracted to the beautiful Zara.

programme.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army.

programme.title: We Still Kill the Old Way
programme.desc: A teacher (Gian Maria Volonte) falls for a woman (Irene Papas) whose husband was recently murdered on a hunting trip.

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: Tomorrow Is Forever
programme.desc: In 1918, Elizabeth MacDonald (Claudette Colbert) learns with shock that her husband, John Andrew (Orson Welles), has been killed in the war. Elizabeth bears John's son and eventually marries her kindly boss. Unknown to her, John has survived but is horribly disfigured and remains in Europe. Years later, on the eve of World War II, Elizabeth refuses to agree to her son's request to enlist and is stunned when an eerily familiar stranger named Kessler arrives from abroad and becomes involved.

programme.title: Separate Tables
programme.desc: During the off-season at the Beauregard Hotel, the secrets of some guests are exposed. Lovely but vulnerable Ann Shankland (Rita Hayworth) travels to the hotel in hopes of starting over with her ex-husband, John (Burt Lancaster), but she does not know that he is already engaged to Pat Cooper (Wendy Hiller), the manager of the hotel. Meanwhile, Mrs. Railton-Bell (Gladys Cooper) and her daughter Sibyl (Deborah Kerr) discover the hidden truth about war veteran Major Pollack (David Niven).

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: For Those Who Think Young
programme.desc: Youth is in full swing at Oceancrest College, and no place swings harder than the Silver Palms, the choice hot spot for student Sandy (Pamela Tiffin) and her pals. Sandy's uncle, Woody (Woody Woodbury), who performs a comedy act at the club, has his livelihood threatened when wealthy conservative Edgar Cronin (Robert Middleton) attempts to shutter the wild hangout for good. This makes things especially sticky for Cronin's grandson, Ding (James Darren), who's trying to get a date with Sandy.

programme.title: Just for Kicks
programme.desc: A stranger tries to help twin brothers (Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse) who play for a winless soccer team.

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Sergeant Deadhead
programme.desc: After setting off a rocket during a parade, Sergeant Deadhead (Frankie Avalon) is sent to a guardhouse by his commanding officer, General Fogg (Fred Clark). While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.desc: In this fact-based film, star prizefighter Barney Ross (Cameron Mitchell) puts his career on hold to fight in World War II. He soon distinguishes himself through his courageous service, but later becomes infected with malaria. He is sent home and treated with morphine, to which he soon becomes addicted. As he descends further into the throes of his deadly habit, his courageous wife, Cathy (Dianne Foster), vows to help her husband kick his addiction before it kills him.

The driver is still at large, and Crawford becomes obsessed with tracking the person down. After a surprising turn of events, Crawford is put on trial for the death of a neighbor, who also happened to be a judge. Initially represented by a younger lawyer, Crawford eventually defends himself in court, despite not having an alibi.

But trouble arises when partners in a comedy duo compete for Rachel's affections.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Catch the Heat
programme.desc: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Youngblood
programme.desc: An angry Vietnam veteran (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs) leads a Los Angeles street gang in a war on drug dealers.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Sonora Stagecoach
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele, Chief Thundercloud) escort an innocent man to a fair trial.

programme.title: Gun Belt
programme.desc: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop).

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: After learning that all the poker games in town cheat their players, Bat starts his own game, but a crooked sheriff arrests him and bans him from poker.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: A marksman's wife convinces him not to take a greedy casino owner up on an agreement to kill Bat, but the casino owner looks for a way to force the murder by any means necessary.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Angered over several recent mine disasters, Sheriff Hollister wages a campaign for mine safety legislation with the aid of Editor Claiborne of the Tombstone Epitaph; in the process, they uncover a clever ruse to discredit the safety campaign.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Adam Kirby witnesses a murder in the livery stable; then makes the mistake of shooting off his mouth about it, leading to the killer coming after him; Sheriff Hollister baits a trap with Kirby and waits to trap the killer and save Kirby.

programme.title: Blazing Guns
programme.desc: The governor sends the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) to tame a cow town.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: A Mexican aristocrat (Michael Pate) dies leading troops against his half brother's rebels (Jock Mahoney) in old California.

programme.title: The Brass Legend
programme.desc: Sheriff Wade Addams is engaged to Linda Gipson and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten. Linda's little brother, Clay, happens upon Tris' hideout one day, and immediately notifies Wade, who arrests the killer. Despite efforts to keep Clay's involvement a secret, the details come out and Clay's life is threatened. Wade must protect Clay while sidestepping attempts on his own life by Tris' henchmen.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli).

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: When pirates stage a daring holdup of the riverboat Dakota Queen and steal $10,000 from Bat, along with other passengers' valuables, Bat takes advantage of their leader's gluttony using a barrel of rare cheeses.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Mace Pomeroy offers Bat a small fortune to command his forces in his railroad war against Gen. Moran.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: When a U.S. Marshal is ambushed while bringing in outlaw Kyle Dodge, he turns his captive over to Sheriff Hollister just before he dies, with the cryptic warning to trust nobody; forewarned, the Sheriff forestalls a clever attempt to free Dodge.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: In order to trap an outlaw gang, the Epitaph reports that a gang member is turning state's witness; the outlaw dies of his wounds, but his death is kept secret; in a bold move, the gang kidnaps Claiborne and offers to exchange him for the outlaw.

programme.title: The Iron Sheriff
programme.desc: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: An 11-year-old Quaker boy sets out across the grasslands of 1880s Montana to avenge his family's deaths.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

programme.title: The Glass Slipper
programme.desc: In a retelling of the "Cinderella" tale, young orphan Ella (Leslie Caron) lives with her unpleasant stepmother (Elsa Lanchester) and stepsisters (Amanda Blake, Lisa Daniels), essentially working as their housekeeper. When the local prince (Michael Wilding) returns from school, a ball is announced. Around that time, Ella meets the prince, who is disguised as the son of the palace chef, and the two fall in love. When she manages to attend the ball, his revealed identity causes quite a stir.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Manuela Alva is unhappily engaged to Don Pedro, the mayor of her town. When a circus arrives, she's enchanted by performer Serafin, who's likewise smitten with her. The mayor tries to evict the circus from town, but Serafin turns the tables after realizing Don Pedro is Macoco, an ex-pirate in hiding. When Serafin learns that Manuela dreams of Macoco, he adopts the discarded identity to woo her — but is then condemned to death for the pirate's crimes.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: This adventure-filled drama finds Englishman Rudolf Rassendyll (Ronald Colman) on vacation in a small European country, where he discovers his resemblance to the nation's royal heir-apparent, Rudolf V. When the king-to-be is drugged and incapacitated, Rassendyll must impersonate him, so that the scheming Duke Michael (Raymond Massey) can't assume the throne. To further complicate matters, Rassendyll starts to fall for Rudolf V's intended bride, Flavia (Madeleine Carroll).

programme.title: Edge of Eternity
programme.desc: Widowed Les Martin is an ex-detective haunted by a case he left behind in Denver. Now, Martin is the deputy sheriff of a small Arizona town with nothing to do but pull over beautiful local socialite Janice Kendon for occasional speeding -- until a mysterious murder at a nearby ghost town requires him to put his old skills to use once again. With the help of Sheriff Edwards and Kendon, Martin must unravel a murderous plot involving stolen gold.

programme.title: Easy Rider
programme.desc: Wyatt (Peter Fonda) and Billy (Dennis Hopper), two Harley-riding hippies, complete a drug deal in Southern California and decide to travel cross-country in search of spiritual truth. On their journey, they experience bigotry and hatred from the inhabitants of small-town America and also meet with other travelers seeking alternative lifestyles. After a terrifying drug experience in New Orleans, the two travelers wonder if they will ever find a way to live peacefully in America.

On the road, beset by hardships, the Joads meet dozens of other families making the same trek and holding onto the same dream. Once in California, however, the Joads soon realize that the promised land isn't quite what they hoped.

programme.title: For Me and My Gal

When success seems right around the corner, Palmer is drafted into the army at the advent of World War I. Thinking quickly, Palmer injures his hand to avoid being called to duty, but Hayden -- whose brother died in the war -- finds his action cowardly and breaks up the duo. Now, Palmer must figure out a way to bring them back together, even if it means going to war.

programme.title: Living in a Big Way

programme.title: The Diary of Anne Frank

A romance with Peter Van Daan causes jealousy between Anne and her sister, Margot. Otto Frank (Joseph Schildkraut) returns to the attic many years after the eventual capture of both families and finds his late daughter's diary.

programme.title: The Best of Everything

programme.title: A Fine Madness

But no more so than is his current wife, Rhoda (Joanne Woodward), who suffers through his daily and casual philandering. But after Rhoda reports his erratic behavior to famously brilliant psychiatrist Dr. Oliver West (Patrick O'Neal), the sociopathic Shillitoe finds himself institutionalized -- though within arm's reach of West's gorgeous partner, Dr. Vera Kropotkin (Colleen Dewhurst).

programme.title: MGM Parade Show

programme.title: Big News
programme.desc: A boozing reporter (Robert Armstrong) is framed for murder by the gangland advertiser who gets him fired.

programme.title: Age of Consent
programme.desc: College kids Betty (Dorothy Wilson) and Michael (Richard Cromwell) are in love. One night, after they resolve a jealousy-fueled fight, they decide to get engaged. Michael is tempted to quit college in order to earn a steady living, but it's a different temptation that proves to be too strong for him, as he falls into the arms of Dora (Arline Judge), a younger girl. After catching Dora with Michael, the girl's strict father tries to force them to marry, threatening Michael's bond with Betty.

programme.title: The Half-Naked Truth
programme.desc: Jimmy Bates (Lee Tracy), a carnival barker, decides to spice up a dance act by spinning a melodramatic story about the exotic dancer's jilted mother. When Jimmy, dancer Teresita (Lupe Velez) and Achilles (Eugene Pallette) are exposed as liars by the town's sheriff, they flee to New York City, where Jimmy leads people to believe that Teresa is a Turkish princess. Jimmy then manages to get Teresa into a theater producer's review-style show, elevating her to fame at a price he hadn't anticipated.

programme.title: Gabriel Over the White House
programme.desc: When Judson Hammond is elected United States president during the Great Depression, he's seen by many as a hands-off, please-everyone type. After an astounding recovery from a car accident, however, Hammond awakes a changed man. Instituting sweeping, radical changes to the government -- including the dissolution of Congress and the revoking of the Constitution -- Hammond somehow manages to bring order to the country through dictatorship, along with world peace.

programme.title: What Every Woman Knows
programme.desc: Aspiring young Scottish politician John Shand (Brian Aherne) enters into an unusual agreement with the wealthy Wylie family -- if they fund his education, he must marry their daughter, Maggie (Helen Hayes). Staying true to his word, John weds Maggie and begins a successful career, thanks largely to his savvy wife. The couple's relationship is placed in jeopardy, though, when John faces temptation in the form of the lovely aristocrat Lady Sybil Tenterden (Madge Evans).

programme.title: She Married Her Boss
programme.desc: After six years of unrequited love for her boss, Richard Barclay (Melvyn Douglas), executive secretary Julia Scott (Claudette Colbert) refuses a job in Paris, yet declares her plans to move to France to find a husband. Fearful of losing Julia's talents, Richard marries her and demands she sort out his messy home life with his young daughter and overbearing sister. When she realizes Richard only wants a business partner, Julia agrees to reorganize a rival's store to gain Richard's attention.

programme.title: Stage Door
programme.desc: A boardinghouse for female theater actresses gets a new arrival in the form of Terry Randall (Katharine Hepburn), an upper-class woman pursuing her dreams against her wealthy father's wishes. At first, her status makes her unpopular with the other boarders, particularly her roommate, Jean (Ginger Rogers). As Terry becomes better acquainted with the other girls and their shared ambitions, rivalry -- both professional and romantic -- explodes among them.

programme.title: Fifth Avenue Girl
programme.desc: Beautiful and young Mary Grey (Ginger Rogers) is unemployed but still maintains a positive outlook. Her charming persona sparks the attention of millionaire Alfred Borden (Walter Connolly), who, despite his fortune, is miserable as his wife, Martha (Verree Teasdale), and their kids pay him little regard. Soon Alfred talks Mary into pretending to be a woman after Alfred's riches, prompting his family to reevaluate the man of the house. Meanwhile, Alfred's son, Tim (Tim Holt), falls for Mary.

programme.title: Primrose Path
programme.desc: Ellie May Adams (Ginger Rogers) lives with her dysfunctional family in a rundown home on Primrose Hill. Hoping not to become a prostitute like her mother (Marjorie Rambeau) and grandmother (Queenie Vassar), Ellie fights to keep her dignity by marrying the charming Ed Wallace (Joel McCrea) and lying about her embarrassing relatives. But Ellie's lies backfire when Ed finally meets the family, and she realizes that she may have to become a prostitute after all.

programme.title: The Movie Man
programme.desc: Amid a global pandemic, an entrepreneur looks back on his life's work owning and operating an idiosyncratic cinema in the forest of northern Ontario.

programme.title: Cinema Paradiso
programme.desc: Young Salvatore Di Vita (Salvatore Cascio) discovers the perfect escape from life in his war-torn Sicilian village: the Cinema Paradiso movie house, where projectionist Alfredo (Philippe Noiret) instills in the boy a deep love of films. When Salvatore grows up, falls in love with a beautiful local girl (Agnese Nano) and takes over as the Paradiso's projectionist, Alfredo must convince Salvatore to leave his small town and pursue his passion for filmmaking.

Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances.

programme.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
programme.desc: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies.

programme.title: Squad Car
programme.desc: An accused man (Don Marlowe) helps a policeman (Paul Bryar) investigate an airplane mechanic's death and a counterfeit racket.

programme.title: Berlin Correspondent
programme.desc: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government.

programme.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
programme.desc: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder.

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself.

programme.sub-title: Ruta 66, EE. UU.: De Nuevo México a California
programme.desc: El 250.o aniversario de los Estados Unidos es la excusa perfecta para unas vacaciones de verano y un gran viaje por carretera al estilo estadounidense. ¿Qué mejor ruta para recorrer que la Ruta 66 en el año de su centenario? Un recorrido por la Ruta 66 te sumerge en la historia del país.

programme.title: The Gunfighter

programme.title: Arizona Raiders

programme.title: Wrath of Man

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2005/06 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2005/06 season. Thierry Henry became the first player in the league's history to win the Golden Boot four times, top-scoring with 27 goals.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2006/07 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2006/07 season. Chelsea's Didier Drogba topped the scoring charts with 20 goals, ahead of Benni McCarthy (18) and Cristiano Ronaldo.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season. Cristiano Ronaldo topped the scoring charts with a remarkable 31 goals, ahead of Fernando Torres and Emmanuel Adebayor on 24.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2008/09 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2008/09 season. Chelsea striker Nicolas Anelka secured the Golden Boot with 19 goals, beating Cristiano Ronaldo to the prize.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2009/10 season
programme.desc: We revisit the best goals from the 2009/2010 season. In his most prolific season for Chelsea, Didier Drogba secured the Golden Boot with 29 goals, three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2010/11 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2010/2011 season. Dimitar Berbatov and Carlos Tevez shared the Golden Boot with 20 goals, ahead of Robin van Persie who finished with 18.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2011/12 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2011/12 season. With 30 goals, Robin van Persie won the Golden Boot in his final season for Arsenal, finishing three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the top strikes from the 2012/13 season
programme.desc: A look back at the top strikes from the 2012/13 season. Robin van Persie finished top of the charts with 26 goals, three ahead of Luis Suarez and five in front of Gareth Bale.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the top goals from the 2013/14 season
programme.desc: A look back at the top goals from the 2013/14 season. Luis Suarez - in his final season at Anfield - finished top scorer with 31 goals, 10 ahead of team-mate Daniel Sturridge.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the most memorable goals from the 2014/15 season
programme.desc: A look back at the most memorable goals from the 2014/15 season. Sergio Aguero won the Golden Boot with 26 goals, five ahead of Harry Kane and six in front of Diego Costa.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the top goals from the 2015/16 season
programme.desc: A look back at the top goals from the 2015/16 season. Harry Kane beat Sergio Aguero and Jamie Vardy to the Golden Boot, while Watford's Odion Ighalo and Troy Deeney also impressed.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season. Harry Kane won the Golden Boot for the second successive season with 29 goals, scoring seven goals in Spurs' last two games.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the best goals from the 2017/18 season

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. programme.desc: Lindsey, Richie and Henry the dog welcome a brand-new presenter to 'Blue Peter'. On their first show, the 39th presenter is thrown straight into a dance challenge; former BP stars share their top tips. Plus, find out all about them through a very special animation.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Oman in search of wolves and giant super pods.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for a lively, curiosity-fuelled exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Anita Rani pays a Christmas visit to Baroness Floella Benjamin to reflect on a remarkable life shaped by family, faith and the festive season.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus plans to bring in some ducks, but things aren't as simple as they seem as he heads out onto the lake to create a new home for them. Heading to Devon, he discovers the perfect breed for the smallholding.

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya shares her effortless, simple celebratory bakes for every day of the week, making special occasions a whole lot easier. She gets the party started with a playful crowd pleaser inspired by her travels to New Orleans.

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Oscar Wilde's comic masterpiece. Set in the 1890s England, a comedy of mistaken identity ensues when two gentlemen friends use the same alias to pursue the women they love.

programme.title: Strangers on a Train
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock's classic about two men who plot a perfect murder. When tennis pro Guy Haines meets smooth-talking Bruno Antony in the bar car of a train, he finds the stranger sympathetic with his desire to be rid of his clinging wife. The sinister Bruno then proposes that they swap murders: Bruno will murder Guy's wife, and Guy will do away with Bruno's father.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Charles Hanson and Adam Partridge unearth all manner of items to auction at the Platform in Morecambe in Lancashire, including French porcelain and Japanese carvings. Paul Martin visits the railway station that was the set for the iconic film `Brief Encounter'.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Bob Harris and Suzi Perry swap music and motors for a Japanese boat and Westwood jewels.

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: In a daring kidnap attempt, a small force of crack German paratroopers are poised to snatch Winston Churchill and return with him to Germany. If they succeed in their mission, it could alter the course of the war.

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 3
programme.desc: A collection of 40 rarely seen musical moments that don't often get to escape from the BBC vaults. Including Roachford, David Bowie, Mary J. Blige and Gloria Estefan.

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2
programme.desc: Another deep dive into the BBC's music archives, where the musical map is pointed away from Top of the Pops on a quest to uncover 40 rarely seen performances and hidden gems.

Focus également sur les rêves de Justine qui se concrétisent : elle vient d'ouvrir, à Leers, dans le Nord, la plus grande friperie de France. Vanessa, de son côté, tente de relancer son salon de coiffure détruit en marge des manifestations du 17 octobre.

programme.title: 13h15, le dimanche...
programme.desc: L'automne est social, le climat éruptif et le pays "craque de partout" dit Sophie Binet. La secrétaire générale de la CGT est une des nouvelles personnalités de "Successions", au cœur des manifestations et des revendications, et d'une certaine convergence de luttes. Le 5 novembre, elle était dans le cortège parisien, le 24 octobre, à Orléans, elle manifestait contre le RN cette fois.

programme.title: 13h15, le samedi...

Face aux difficultés actuelles il existe encore des irréductibles qui décident de prendre la mer envers et contre tout. programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Bretagne au Grand Est, des Hauts-de-France à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: Triple je
programme.desc: Ils se ressemblent comme trois gouttes d’eau… mais n’ont rien d’autre en commun ! À 45 ans, Richard Deltour, cadre rigide et tradi, découvre du jour au lendemain qu’il a deux frères jumeaux ! Le premier, David, dirige une association LGBTQIA+ et milite pour un monde plus inclusif. Le second, José, arnaqueur sans talent, enchaîne les galères avec un certain panache, mais la dernière en date pourrait bien lui coûter la vie. Pour Richard, ces retrouvailles virent à la catastrophe. D’autant qu’il décide de cacher leur existence à sa famille ! Il a maintenant une semaine pour ne pas perdre son job, et surtout son épouse, Alice, qui s’apprête à le quitter. Ces triplés que tout oppose vont devoir apprendre à se supporter, et aussi à s’entraider… Et qui sait, peut-être même arriveront-ils à s’apprécier un peu ? Voire à s’aimer ?

programme.title: Cauchemar en cuisine
programme.desc: C'est à Notre-Dame-de-Vaulx, en Isère, que Béatrice a fait appel au chef Philippe Etchebest. Avec son compagnon Patrice, ils ont ouvert un restaurant il y a près de deux ans et, aujourd'hui, leur situation est au plus mal : la fermeture est proche.\r\nPourtant situé dans un charmant village de montagne, le chef a vite déchanté quand il a découvert le restaurant : entre la décoration dédiée aux motos et à Johnny Hallyday, des plats qui ne donnent vraiment pas envie et surtout une cuisine dans un état déplorable, Philippe Etchebest s'est retrouvé face à un couple complètement déboussolé et sans aucune réaction.\r\nPour tenter de leur venir en aide, le chef a mis en place une nouvelle méthode avec un électrochoc : il a demandé aux clients de noter leur repas et a une nouvelle fois sollicité Mallory Gabsi, un ancien candidat de Top Chef, pour gérer un gros service avec eux. Et ce service, le Chef Etchebest va l'analyser en compagnie de Béatrice et Patrice pour déterminer s'ils sont capables d'ouvrir à nouveau et de tenir un restaurant….

programme.title: Cauchemar en cuisine
programme.desc:
C'est à Strasbourg, en Alsace, que Philippe Etchebest a été appelé à l'aide par Damir. Il y a presque un an, Damir, son épouse Amira et son neveu Adil ont quitté le Sud de la France pour reprendre un restaurant en Alsace.
Après avoir travaillé de nombreuses années dans la restauration, ils avaient tout pour réaliser leur rêve, mais depuis quelques mois, faute de clients, ils sont dans une situation financière catastrophique : il leur reste moins de deux mois avant de devoir mettre la clé sous la porte, un véritable cauchemar pour cette famille…
Et avec les problèmes qui s'accumulent, il est de plus en plus difficile pour eux de travailler ensemble, surtout pour Damir et son neveu Adil. Leur relation s'est dégradée et, semaine après semaine, les confrontations sont de plus en plus violentes. Cette situation est en train de complétement déchirer cette famille, pourtant si unie il y a quelques mois…
Philippe Etchebest va donc devoir relever un véritable défi : si le restaurant ne se redresse pas très rapidement, ils vont tout perdre, et c'est toute une famille qui risque d'exploser….

programme.title: Absolument stars
programme.desc: Chaque semaine, Absolument Stars vous propose de découvrir toute l'actualité people, musique, ciné et spectacle.

programme.title: Le mag du samedi
programme.desc: Le mag du samedi invite à découvrir les coulisses d’événements spectaculaires, des success stories entrepreneuriales comme des immersions dans le quotidien de ceux qui participent activement à construire l’avenir de notre pays. C’est un magazine sur la société d’aujourd’hui, celle qui nous inspire et nous fait rêver.

programme.title: Made in France : ils inventent l’industrie de demain
programme.desc:
Direction La Rochelle pour rencontrer le premier candidat : Clément, 22 ans, alternant chez Shark Robotics. Étudiant en master de génie industriel, il travaille sur le cerveau numérique du Colossus, un robot pompier de 700 kilos déjà entré dans la légende en 2019 lors de l'incendie de Notre-Dame de Paris. Son défi : développer une nouvelle version encore plus performante, capable de collecter et d'analyser les données de tous ses capteurs embarqués pour améliorer ses interventions. Un projet hors norme qui a tout pour séduire sa mentor, Caroline Semin, PDG du groupe Semin, qui fait le déplacement depuis Paris pour l'encourager et lui prodiguer ses premiers conseils.
À 700 kilomètres de là, près de Valence, Eva, 22 ans, étudiante en master de chimie verte et éco-innovation, est en alternance chez Chestnut, une petite entreprise spécialisée dans la valorisation des déchets agricoles. Son projet : créer une biosolution à base de peaux d'oignons afin de trouver une alternative aux pesticides conventionnels. Accompagnée de son tuteur, elle attend avec impatience les résultats de ses analyses, envoyées à Reims. Les premiers retours sont prometteurs…
C'est à Chambéry que vous rencontrerez Clément, 19 ans, le benjamin de la compétition. Il est en BTS de conception de produits industriels. En alternance chez Infiplast, spécialiste des dispositifs médicaux, il travaille sur un projet qui pourrait sauver des vies : une boîte de transport conçue pour maintenir un greffon cardiaque dans des conditions optimales, avec pour ambition de faire passer le temps de transport de 4 à 16 heures. Ce projet allie la créativité et des enjeux médicaux majeurs.
Direction Orléans pour retrouver Léna, 22 ans, alternante depuis deux ans chez Servier, le grand laboratoire pharmaceutique français. Son projet : concevoir un emballage pharmaceutique recyclable en remplacement des blisters actuels, impossibles à recycler. Un défi technique de taille, qui implique de trouver un matériau à la fois étanche, recyclable et conforme aux exigences strictes de l'industrie pharmaceutique. Elle reçoit la visite de son mentor Benjamin Saada, fondateur de Fairmat, spécialiste du recyclage des matériaux composites. Après un premier essai perfectible, Léna retravaille son pitch et convainc progressivement son mentor, qui voit en elle une vraie candidate à la victoire.
Enfin, vous ferez la connaissance d'un cinquième candidat : Théo, 22 ans, passionné de tir à l'arc, déterminé et tenace. Son projet, gardé secret, vous sera dévoilé dans le prochain épisode.

programme.title: Les routes du goût - La ballade d'Emma
programme.desc: La cheffe étoilée Georgina Viou retourne à Marseille pour un voyage culinaire unique. Elle y mêle traditions méditerranéennes et influences béninoises.

programme.title: Ça commence aujourd'hui
programme.sub-title: Ils conservent, ils accumulent... et leur maison finit par déborder !
programme.desc: Ils conservent, ils accumulent... et leur maison finit par déborder Faustine Bollaert reçoit des invités qui entassent et accumulent des objets jusqu'à en faire déborder leur maison.

programme.title: Un si grand soleil
programme.desc: Tandis qu'un nouveau témoignage vient sceller le sort de Jérémy, Pablo commence à voir Salomé autrement.

programme.title: Neige
programme.desc: Pour faire avancer son enquête sur des meurtres de notables, un policier fait équipe avec une détenue incarcérée pour des faits étrangement similaires.

programme.title: L'épicerie
programme.sub-title: Économiser en magasin grâce à l'IA
programme.desc: Au programme : Test de différents outils afin de savoir si l'IA permet aussi de réduire la facture de courses en plus d'économiser sur la charge mentale, test de goût de sauces à pizza et la folie matcha.

programme.title: C'est du belge
programme.desc: À la veille d'Halloween, direction une impressionnante maison hantée conçue par une entreprise belge. Focus sur une gourde capable de conserver le pétillant des boissons. Les très attendus \" Bisou Awards \", qui révèlent les nouvelles étoiles du Web. Au coeur du MoMu, le prestigieux musée de la mode d'Anvers.

programme.title: Le match dans le match
programme.desc: Thierry Boutsen, emblématique pilote de Formule 1 belge des années 1980 et 1990, revient sur ses débuts en sport automobile, ses victoires et les défis du pilotage. Il évoque ses projets actuels et partage son regard sur l'évolution de la discipline et son admiration pour Charles Leclerc.

programme.title: Destination francophonie
programme.desc: L'exploration scandinave se poursuit à Odense, une des plus anciennes villes du pays, et Aarhus, la "ville du sourire". Le musée ARoS, les SeaRangers, puis Frederikshavn et Læsø, avec ses salines ancestrales. Dernière étape, Skagen, au bout du Danemark, là où la mer du Nord rencontre la Baltique.

programme.title: Objectif Monde : l'hebdo
programme.desc: Territoire méconnu aux confins de l'Arctique, à mi-chemin entre l'Europe continentale et le pôle Nord, le Svalbard est devenu l'un des laboratoires scientifiques du changement climatique. Mais l'archipel norvégien revêt aussi un fort intérêt géostratégique car il pourrait servir d'alibi à la Russie pour attaquer le pays.

programme.title: Tout le monde veut prendre sa place
Un pays, un livre
programme.desc: Dans "Le pays sans ombre", un recueil de nouvelles, Abdourahman Waberi décrit un pays marqué par la violence, la misère, les croyances populaires et les tensions sociales.

programme.title: Le grand concert de la Francophonie célèbre Jean-Jacques Goldman
La grande galerie francophone
programme.desc: Comédien sur scène comme à l'écran, François-Xavier Demaison est à l'affiche de la pièce "Laponie". L'artiste contemporaine Inès Longevial séduit les galeries du monde entier.

programme.title: La Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Résumé quotidien de la Route du Rhum 2026 - Destination Guadeloupe, course transatlantique en solitaire qui relie, tous les quatre ans, Saint-Malo, en Bretagne, à Pointe-à-Pitre, en Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Six degrés
programme.sub-title: La popularité vous va si bien
programme.desc: Alors que Francis prépare son voyage, Julietta organise la maison pour la venue de sa cousine Amanda. Ricardo et Doris vivent une période difficile.

programme.desc: Au sommaire : "Double homicide volontaire". Elodie, une jeune maman de 30 ans, vit avec son compagnon dans un quartier paisible de Mont-de-Marsan, dans les Landes. Mais le 27 mars 2016, Elodie et sa petite sont retrouvées sans vie à leur domicile. - "Guet-apens mortel". Christian, 61 ans, vit près de Toulouse. PDG de la plus importante entreprise de la région, il est retrouvé criblé de balles devant sa propriété.

Dans chaque épisode, un particulier nous ouvre ses portes, convaincu de posséder une pépite : timbres rares, bijoux de famille, vase ancien ou vieil instrument oublié. Il nous confie l'estimation qu'il en fait et ce qu'il rêve d'accomplir avec cette somme. Rendez-vous ensuite chez un commissaire-priseur, dont le verdict expert réserve parfois de cruelles désillusions… ou de belles surprises !!

programme.title: MMA : Cage Warriors
programme.desc: L'événement Cage Warriors 213 se déroule au BBC Studioworks Television Centre de Londres. Véritable prodige du MMA britannique et redoutable finisseur par soumission, il fait face au vétéran de l'UFC brésilien Bruno Souza. A suivre également un duel chez les poids mi-moyens entre le Britannique Steven Hill et le Turc Sado "The Panther" Ucar.

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Laurence de Schepper : suicide ou féminicide ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
Le 11 janvier 2018, le corps de Laurence de Schepper, 48 ans, est retrouvé dans les eaux glacées de la Sambre. Sa voiture est découverte à quelques centaines de mètres de son domicile. Très vite, l’enquête s’oriente vers la piste d’un suicide. Il faut dire que Laurence traversait une période difficile. Suivie en psychiatrie pour dépression, fragilisée par des antécédents suicidaires, elle venait tout juste de sortir d’hospitalisation. Elle ne pesait plus que 40 kilos et refusait parfois de s’alimenter. Pour les enquêteurs, ces éléments semblent accréditer la thèse d’un passage à l’acte. Mais pour sa famille, ce scénario ne tient pas. Le soir de sa disparition, pourquoi Laurence serait-elle sortie vêtue d’une simple robe de chambre rose ? Pourquoi ses lunettes, indispensables pour conduire, ne se trouvaient-elles pas dans son véhicule ? Et surtout, comment cette femme qui avait peur de l’eau aurait-elle pu se jeter dans la Sambre, en plein hiver, par –4 °C et avec des rafales de vent atteignant 37 km/h ? Au fil des mois, les questions se multiplient. Ses carnets intimes s’interrompent brusquement en septembre 2017, alors que ses proches assurent qu’elle écrivait encore quelques semaines avant sa mort. Un dernier SMS, reçu par sa fille et censé avoir été envoyé par Laurence, intrigue, lui aussi, la famille : le message provient bien de son téléphone, mais son authenticité est contestée.
Un autre élément attire l’attention : la veille de l’annonce de la disparition, David Cornez, son compagnon, retire 600 euros. Il affirme que Laurence lui aurait demandé cette somme afin d’offrir un cadeau de Noël à ses enfants. Une explication que ces derniers réfutent catégoriquement. Surtout, peu avant sa mort, Laurence aurait confié à ses proches qu’elle souhaitait rompre avec David Cornez et récupérer les clés de son domicile. Une décision qu’il aurait mal acceptée. Et pourquoi a-t-il attendu le lendemain matin pour signaler sa disparition ? Pourquoi a-t-il vidé son compte bancaire ? Enfin, comment expliquer que le bornage de son téléphone le situe à proximité du lieu où Laurence a été retrouvée, entre 9 h 01 et 11 h 41, sans qu’il ne l’ait déclaré ? Pour la famille de Laurence de Schepper, il ne s’agit pas d’un suicide, mais d’un féminicide. Alors, que s’est-il réellement passé dans les dernières heures de cette mère de famille ?

À la suite, Enquêtes criminelles revient sur une affaire qui a soulevé une vague d'émotion et d'indignation dans tout le pays en février 2025. À Épinay-sur-Orge (Essonne), alors qu’elle rentrait du collège, Louise, 11 ans, est poignardée à mort par un mystérieux individu en doudoune noire. Sur la vidéosurveillance, des voisins reconnaissent Owen L., 23 ans, un jeune homme accro aux jeux vidéo violents et connu de la police. Comment ce drame gratuit et cruel a-t-il bien pu se passer ?

Mais pour sa famille, ce scénario ne tient pas. Le soir de sa disparition, pourquoi Laurence serait-elle sortie vêtue d’une simple robe de chambre rose ? Pourquoi ses lunettes, indispensables pour conduire, ne se trouvaient-elles pas dans son véhicule ? Et surtout, comment cette femme qui avait peur de l’eau aurait-elle pu se jeter dans la Sambre, en plein hiver, par –4 °C et avec des rafales de vent atteignant 37 km/h ? Au fil des mois, les questions se multiplient. Ses carnets intimes s’interrompent brusquement en septembre 2017, alors que ses proches assurent qu’elle écrivait encore quelques semaines avant sa mort. Un dernier SMS, reçu par sa fille et censé avoir été envoyé par Laurence, intrigue, lui aussi, la famille : le message provient bien de son téléphone, mais son authenticité est contestée.
Un autre élément attire l’attention : la veille de l’annonce de la disparition, David Cornez, son compagnon, retire 600 euros. Il affirme que Laurence lui aurait demandé cette somme afin d’offrir un cadeau de Noël à ses enfants. Une explication que ces derniers réfutent catégoriquement. Surtout, peu avant sa mort, Laurence aurait confié à ses proches qu’elle souhaitait rompre avec David Cornez et récupérer les clés de son domicile. Une décision qu’il aurait mal acceptée. Et pourquoi a-t-il attendu le lendemain matin pour signaler sa disparition ? Pourquoi a-t-il vidé son compte bancaire ? Enfin, comment expliquer que le bornage de son téléphone le situe à proximité du lieu où Laurence a été retrouvée, entre 9 h 01 et 11 h 41, sans qu’il ne l’ait déclaré ? Pour la famille de Laurence de Schepper, il ne s’agit pas d’un suicide, mais d’un féminicide. Alors, que s’est-il réellement passé dans les dernières heures de cette mère de famille ?

À la suite, Enquêtes criminelles revient sur une affaire qui a soulevé une vague d'émotion et d'indignation dans tout le pays en février 2025. À Épinay-sur-Orge (Essonne), alors qu’elle rentrait du collège, Louise, 11 ans, est poignardée à mort par un mystérieux individu en doudoune noire. Sur la vidéosurveillance, des voisins reconnaissent Owen L., 23 ans, un jeune homme accro aux jeux vidéo violents et connu de la police. Comment ce drame gratuit et cruel a-t-il bien pu se passer ?

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Yves Chatain : un tueur en série en liberté ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
C’est l’histoire d’un crime résolu de façon inattendue, presque inespérée, après trente-six ans de mystère. 
Le 8 mai 2022, Yves Chatain, un chauffeur routier de 56 ans, avoue le meurtre de Marie-Thérèse Bonfanti, une jeune mère de famille disparue à Pontcharra (Isère) le 22 mai 1986. Pour les proches de la mère de famille, cette révélation a un goût amer. Car le suspect pourrait bien ne jamais aller en prison ! En effet, pour la justice, le crime serait prescrit. C’est d’autant plus cruel et frustrant que le suspect était dans le dossier depuis le début : la maison devant laquelle Marie-Thérèse s’est volatilisée appartenait en effet à Yves Chatain, et plusieurs témoignages, dont celui du mari de la disparue, attestent de la présence du propriétaire sur les lieux ce jour-là ! Comment est-il possible que l’homme n’ait pas vraiment été inquiété alors qu’à l’époque il avait déjà été condamné pour des faits de violence ?
Et ce n’est pas tout : l’affaire Bonfanti ne serait pas un cas isolé. Yves Chatain est aujourd’hui suspecté dans plusieurs autres affaires criminelles… 

À la suite, Enquêtes criminelles revient sur la disparition en septembre 2018 près de Strasbourg de Sophie Le Tan. L’étudiante de 20 ans avait répondu à une offre sur un site de petites annonces gratuites : un studio pas trop cher à Schiltigheim. Seulement, elle n’est jamais revenue du rendez-vous. Serait-elle tombée dans un piège ? Les policiers remontent le fil de l’enquête jusqu’à Jean-Marc Reiser. Un homme au profil particulièrement inquiétant et qui habite justement dans l’immeuble où Sophie Le Tan devait se rendre….
